title: Customer data disclosure through compromised identity or service
control_ids: AC-2; AC-3; AC-6; IA-2; AU-2; SC-8; SC-28
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Severe privacy/trust impact; identity attacks are credible while real IAM and data exposure are unknown.

title: Training data poisoning or corruption
risk_source: Insider supply chain or process failure
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Corruption may scale into systematic recommendations; real lineage validation and approvals are unknown.

title: Open-source AI/software supply-chain compromise
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Open-source reliance is known but exact sources provenance build isolation and credentials are unknown.

title: Unauthorized model modification or deployment
control_ids: AC-5; AC-6; AU-2; CM-3; CM-5; SI-7
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] A privileged change can affect recommendations at scale; promotion controls are unknown.

title: Model extraction or inference privacy attack
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Feasibility depends on interface access output precision rate limits and training-data sensitivity.

title: Recommendation service denial or dependency outage
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Business impact and fallback/RTO are unknown; exposed APIs and AI compute can be resource constrained.

title: Unfair or invalid group performance
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Customer impact is potentially severe; actual groups uses thresholds and legal context are unknown.

title: Undetected model/data drift degrades recommendations
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Periodic use implies drift can occur; monitoring and retraining triggers are unknown.

title: Privileged insider misuse across data model or administration
control_ids: AC-2; AC-5; AC-6; AU-6; CM-5; IA-2
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Privileged access is necessary somewhere in the lifecycle; actual separation monitoring and reviews are unknown.

title: Sensitive data leakage through logs and evidence
rationale: [ASSUMPTION] ML observability may collect high-dimensional request/output data; log schema and access are unknown.
